scope: Desktop Thumbnail includes active pencil, brush, eraser, line/rectangle/ellipse and bitmap/font text through shared private command staging. Main-canvas shape/text previews use their final raster commands. No history publication is required to display a draft.
resource_boundary: One worker and one pending job. Committed sources have a 1 GiB raster cap; live staging reserves STAGED_PIXELS_MAX*4 + 256 MiB (1.25 GiB), plus 8 MiB declared scratch. Output ownership of 12 bytes per sample, at most 256x256, is admitted before scheduling and retained through UI handoff. Native shared budget remains 3 GiB. These are logical reservations, not physical RSS or latency measurements.
scope_guards: Document/state/epoch and preview-owner scopes reject stale or cancelled drafts. Same-gesture older frames may be shown only as Updating preview. Cancelling/replacing a gesture removes incompatible images and drains charged work.

checks.clippy: Strict workspace all-targets and wasm32 web Clippy passed
checks.web: 1 host test and optimized bundle passed; browser document thumbnails were not implemented by this slice
checks.gpu: Four actual-App Wgpu scenes exported and visually reviewed: light held rectangle, dark held ellipse, editable font text and compact editable text. Main canvas and overview track each other.

limits: T15 remains partial; native Windows geometry/rendering parity is not established.
The existing shape raster kernel is visibly aliased; this change does not establish native shape antialiasing.
No performance, physical memory, OS accessibility, live native menu or cross-browser conformance claim.
